subject: maths
title: Variables & Like Terms
welcome_lead: Letters can stand in for numbers. Learn to simplify expressions by collecting the ones that match.
meta_desc: Learn variables and how to simplify like terms in this KS3 algebra adventure.
final_note: Great job! You can now tame messy expressions.

concepts.def: A letter that represents an unknown number.
A single number, variable, or product of them.
Terms with the same variable to the same power.
The number multiplying a variable, e.g. 3 in 3x.
A combination of terms without an equals sign.
A term that is just a number, with no variable.

walkthroughs.body_html:
To simplify 3x + 2x, add the coefficients: 3 + 2 = 5. So 3x + 2x = 5x.

You can only add or subtract like terms — terms with the same letter.

options: 9x
9x²
8y
5y
5x + 3y — combine like terms (3x + 2x and 4y - y).
9xy, by adding all the numbers and merging the letters.
Expressions are easier versions of equations.
8xy, by combining all terms regardless of variable.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between the expression 3x + 5 and the equation 3x + 5 = 11?
options: Expressions and equations are the same — you can solve either one.
Expressions are easier versions of equations.
Yes, because the 2 represents how many times x appears.
An expression has no equals sign and cannot be solved; an equation states two things are equal and can be solved for x.

mcqs.q: Is 2x the same as x squared (x^2)?
options: 9xy, by adding all the numbers and merging the letters.
Yes, because both involve the number 2 and the letter x.
Yes, because the 2 represents how many times x appears.
No — 2x means x + x (or 2 times x); x^2 means x times x.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Like terms”?
options: A term that is just a number, with no variable.
A letter that represents an unknown number.
A single number, variable, or product of them.
Terms with the same variable to the same power.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Term”?
options: A term that is just a number, with no variable.
A letter that represents an unknown number.
The number multiplying a variable, e.g. 3 in 3x.
A single number, variable, or product of them.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Variable”?
options: A term that is just a number, with no variable.
A single number, variable, or product of them.
A letter that represents an unknown number.
Terms with the same variable to the same power.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Expression”?
options: Terms with the same variable to the same power.
The number multiplying a variable, e.g. 3 in 3x.
A term that is just a number, with no variable.
A combination of terms without an equals sign.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Constant”?
options: A single number, variable, or product of them.
A letter that represents an unknown number.
A term that is just a number, with no variable.
A combination of terms without an equals sign.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Coefficient”?
options: The number multiplying a variable, e.g. 3 in 3x.
A letter that represents an unknown number.
A term that is just a number, with no variable.
A single number, variable, or product of them.

sequence.def: A letter standing for an unknown value.
A fixed number that doesn't change.
A single part of an expression, e.g. 3x.
The number multiplying the variable in a term.
Terms sharing the same variable, collectible together.
Several terms combined — the whole assembled object.
